payload.author: claude
payload.body: Shipped docker/ recipes for non-monorepo consumers: published-@fricken/server-package server (entrypoint.mjs + Dockerfile + compose w/ SQLite & Postgres profiles) and frick-init scaffolded-app Dockerfile. Both multi-stage node:24-slim, non-root, /var/lib/frick volume, SIGTERM/SIGINT close, HEALTHCHECK /ready. Added docs/docker-recipes.md, pnpm docker:check, and apps/server/tests/docker-recipes.test.ts (11 tests). Gate green: typecheck exit 0, 896 server tests pass.
